config.description: ATLAS M3 pre-registered protocol: horizon-specific prediction intervals (80 % and 95 %) and threshold-exceedance probabilities for the M2 recursive 30-day forecasts on legacy-v0, calibrated only on residuals whose target date was observed by the issue date (latency 0 days, as in M2). Residuals come from the M2 engine re-run at every origin 2024-02-01..2026-06-29. Interval method and calibration scheme are selected on m3_selection (origins 2024-08-01..2025-05-31, scoring only M2 development-period targets) by mean WIS for the M2-recommended atlas_linear_regression, sealed, then evaluated on m3_evaluation (origins 2025-06-30..2026-05-31, the M2 confirmation period, already exposed in M2 and therefore a historical evaluation, not an untouched test). Candidates, baselines, thresholds, pooling rule and decision criteria were fixed before any M3 run on these data.

periods.description: Interval-method selection. Starts six months after the first residual origin so that every horizon has at least 100 eligible calibration origins at the first issue; scores only M2 development-period targets (through 2025-06-30).
periods.name: m3_selection

periods.description: Historical evaluation of the sealed choice on the M2 confirmation origins (targets 2025-07-01..2026-06-30). Already exposed in M2: not an untouched prospective test.
periods.name: m3_evaluation

thresholds.description: 75th percentile (linear interpolation) of the observed daily counts in the 180 days ending at each forecast's data cutoff: the legacy 'planning capacity' rule recomputed at every origin. A high-demand reference derived from incoming requests, not a measured service capacity.
thresholds.label: trailing180_p75

thresholds.assumptions: Illustrative round number set above the legacy demand percentile of 11,609 requests per day. It is not derived from staffing, budgets, closures, backlog or service-level targets (none exist in the repository) and does not represent the capacity of any NYC agency; it only demonstrates how a user-supplied capacity threshold is handled.
thresholds.label: hypothetical_capacity_12000

thresholds.assumptions: Second illustrative round number, 1,000 requests per day above the first, chosen without reference to any operational data; it does not represent the capacity of any NYC agency and exists to show that probabilities fall as the threshold rises.
thresholds.label: hypothetical_capacity_13000

label: FUTURE PROJECTION WITH INTERVALS: forecasts beyond the last observed day with prediction intervals and exceedance probabilities calibrated on past errors. No outcome has been observed; read the calibration status before using them.

models.description: Modernised regression atlas-m2-regression-v1: 18 non-collinear M1 features plus intercept, OLS on standardised columns (full rank required), recursive, clipped at 0.
Median of the 5 most recent observed values on the target's weekday (on or before the origin).

status_guidance: The selected intervals FAILED the pre-registered calibration criteria on the historical evaluation period: these intervals and probabilities are not decision-grade.
